comment: Estimated figures and counted figures the pages render. Money in whole US cents and whole naira. Every entry names its source and the date it was last checked. Change a figure here, rebuild, and every page that uses it changes.

estimates.label: Staples for two meals a day
estimates.source_title: Feeding at Bethesda: what two meals cost and what a third would add
estimates.note: Rice, beans, Indomie noodles and semolina only, at Lagos market prices found online in October 2026, converted at the bank rate in rates.json.

estimates.label: Two meals a day with soup, stew, oil and fuel
estimates.source_title: Feeding at Bethesda: what two meals cost and what a third would add
estimates.note: Staples plus a third to a half again for what makes them a meal. The widest of these estimates.

estimates.label: A third meal, staples only
estimates.source_title: Feeding at Bethesda: what two meals cost and what a third would add
estimates.note: Half again what two meals cost, using the same foods.

estimates.label: A third meal with soup, stew, oil and fuel
estimates.source_title: Feeding at Bethesda: what two meals cost and what a third would add
estimates.note: A lighter third meal, such as a breakfast of pap and akara or bread and tea, could cost about half this. Bethesda has been asked what the third meal used to be.

estimates.label: A third meal for one child
estimates.source_title: Feeding at Bethesda: what two meals cost and what a third would add
estimates.note: The third-meal monthly estimates divided by the number of boarders. The clearest single figure on this site.

estimates.label: A third meal for everyone, for a year
estimates.source_title: Feeding at Bethesda: what two meals cost and what a third would add
estimates.note: Staples only at the low end, everything at the high end. Feeding is a cost that never ends, so it needs giving that repeats.
